description: This file provides an API client module for interacting with a backend server, supporting modes for both enabled ('http') and fallback ('disabled') operation. It includes utility functions for URL normalization and HTTP JSON requests, as well as the main createApiClient() factory function that returns an object with methods to perform CRUD operations on products.

methods.name: normalizeBaseUrl(url)
methods.description: Sanitizes the provided URL by removing any trailing slash. Returns an empty string if the URL is falsy.

methods.name: httpJson(url, init)
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to the specified URL with given options, parsing the response JSON if successful, and throwing an error if the response is not OK.

methods.name: createApiClient(config)
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a configured API client object with methods to interact with product endpoints, operating in 'http' mode if a base URL is provided, or in 'disabled' mode otherwise.
